The vendor directly providing **Flipsnack** at **flipsnack.com** is **Flipsnack, Inc.** (formerly Flipsnack LLC).

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official **Terms of Service** for Flipsnack (`legal.flipsnack.com/terms-of-service`):
> *"Legal entity update. Please note that Flipsnack LLC has converted to and now operates as Flipsnack, Inc... 1. Overview. Flipsnack and the services provided ('Services') are maintained and operated by Flipsnack, Inc. ('us', 'we', 'our', 'the Company')."*
